title: Hello BadCode Picks
eyebrow: Hello, I'm BadCode · the logo · round 10
heading: The logo, rolling in
intro: Your note: 'all of the letters are somewhat circular so make them roll, also make a few of these that vary and are interesting'. Four new reveals made from the logo's own pieces (ring, triangle, each letter), each ending exactly as the logo file is. Unmute for the thump. The real reel footage search is still running; the new reel comes next.

sections.lede: All pass the flashing check. Pick one, or mix two in a note.

groups.title: How the logo arrives: four new ways
groups.line: Pick one (or a, b, c from the first three, below).

opts.label: d: roll in: each letter rolls in like a wheel and lands, then the ring rolls in, the triangle pops
e: the dot leads: the red-dot o rolls across, each letter pops up as it passes, the dot rolls home, the ring drops in
f: watching you: the ring appears, the red triangle glances round inside it like an eye, then looks at you
g: dial spin: the ring spins in like a dial with the triangle orbiting, lands on its spot, the letters roll in

sections.lede: Each one is 3 s and passes the flashing check. The logo itself is never redrawn, only moved and scaled.

groups.title: How the logo arrives (first three)
groups.line: Pick one, or mix (e.g. 'a, but with c's glitch at the end').

opts.label: a: out of the eye: start inside the red triangle, pull back to the whole logo (Netflix's move, reversed)
b: power on: an old-telly switch-on line opens into the logo (fits the 2000s opening)
c: glitch in: the logo arrives in broken slices, then snaps clean

sections.lede: The 13 Nov call said the same about the script: "a very basic interpretation… BadCode wouldn't say that." The four directions use the canon the short never mentions: BadCode removed humanity, got bored, found 100 survivors who'd logged off, regretted it.

opts.label: A, the confession: BadCode isn't warning you about the disaster, it WAS the disaster, and it's here to apologise. Strongest hook.
